items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer; create a project game sprite, not a poster. Generate ONE isolated frontal floating horned skull from the FIRST reference, hand-painted in the exact polished fantasy illustration style of the SECOND reference. The first reference defines its silhouette and anatomy: very wide thin upward-splayed horns, silver-white and icy blue bony face, dark indigo shadows, sharply slanted intensely glowing RED eyes, triangular nose cavity, vertically open toothy mouth and fanged lower jaw tapering downward. Preserve this skull's facial proportions and intimidating expression, do not substitute a human skull or add a body. The second reference supplies only painterly detail, edge quality, and palette harmony. Skull only, no city, scenery, stone border, letters, smoke, pedestal, or extra ornaments. True transparent background. Center the full horn-to-horn skull with a small transparent margin; no cropping. Crisp hand-painted shapes, rich blue-violet shadows, detailed bones, matching 1990s dark fantasy illustration rather than pixel art or photorealism. Output a single transparent RGBA sprite suitable for downsampling to approximately 270 by 180 pixels.
